Same here on macOS, Claude Code (Team plan, premium seat), Taiwan residential ISP, no VPN/proxy.

- Error: "Failed to authenticate. API Error: 403 Attention Required! | Cloudflare"

- Re-sending / continuing works afterwards without re-login.
- Also reproduced on a second machine (Windows) around the same time.
